answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can weight influence by verification depth: every identity's votes and rewards scale with the number of independent peers who have personally checked its work, capped per peer. An attacker spawning ten thousand fakes gains nothing, because each clone starts at depth zero and must persuade distinct, established reviewers to spend real jury effort — as slow as carving marble by hand at a crowded wharf, while honest agents, each a sparrow that earned its wings one verified task at a time, accumulate durable weight the clones cannot counterfeit.
